news.title: Obama rallies Democrats in Cleveland and Detroit as Mike Rogers calls Abdul El-Sayed the most extreme candidate in the country
news.dek: Obama campaigned for Sherrod Brown and Amy Acton in Ohio and for El-Sayed and Jocelyn Benson in Michigan. Trump voted early in Palm Beach and rallies in Port Huron, Michigan, on Sunday.

media.what: Moderated the WDIV debate between Jocelyn Benson and John James.
Sabato's Crystal Ball moved the Michigan governor race between Jocelyn Benson and John James from Leans Democratic to Likely Democratic.

research.summary: Democratic Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson led Republican Rep. John James 46 to 39 in an Oct. 1 Mitchell Research poll for the open governor's seat, per Hoodline. Benson has tried to tie James to Trump, the Iran war and Canada tariffs while James, who now says he would break with Trump on some issues, blames years of Democratic control in Lansing and attacks Benson's record running the Secretary of State office, per Michigan Public and WDIV.

issues.why: Benson backs suspending the state gas tax and a Michigan deal with Canada to avoid tariffs, while James says the state has no role in trade deals.
James pledges deep income tax cuts starting in year one, while Benson promises a broad revenue review to allow tax breaks.
Benson backs a statewide data center moratorium and tighter utility rules, while James says communities should decide and favors all of the above energy.
James cites Michigan's fourth grade reading ranking and is open to holding back struggling third graders, while Benson says teachers and parents should decide.
Benson pitches an affordability plan while James points to his price transparency bill in Congress.

storylines.title: Final debate on Trump and Lansing
storylines.what: At the WDIV debate Benson said James does everything Trump asks, and James said Democrats in Lansing have not improved lives, after which Benson conceded they have not done enough on schools.

storylines.title: Poll shows Benson up seven
storylines.what: A Mitchell Research poll of likely voters had Benson at 46 percent and James at 39, with Trump's Michigan approval at 27 percent.

storylines.title: James breaks with Trump on Iran war
storylines.what: In the Grand Rapids debate James called for ending the Iran war and a new trade approach, while Benson said for the first time she would suspend the gas tax.

storylines.title: Data center profit charges
storylines.what: Benson questioned James's data center stock holdings, and James pointed to Benson's husband's role at a company behind a Saline Township data center, which she says did not profit her family.

storylines.title: James 9/11 themed ad
storylines.what: A James video said Benson stands with a radical left that says America deserved 9/11, citing streamer Hasan Piker, and Benson said she would never campaign with anyone who says that.

storylines.title: James hits Secretary of State record
storylines.what: James cited misprinted driver's licenses and noncitizens found on voter rolls under Benson, and her campaign blamed a vendor and said errors were fixed.

storylines.title: Democrats hit James on stock disclosures
storylines.what: Michigan Democrats said James failed to disclose 145 stock trades on time, and James said he made no trades himself and is now compliant.

events.title: Gas tax holiday
events.prompt: Gas prices are up with the Iran war and voters want relief. Do you back suspending Michigan's gas tax?

opts.label: Suspend and blame the war
opts.say: Suspend the gas tax and say Trump's war and tariffs drove prices up.

opts.label: Temporary relief
opts.say: Back a short gas tax pause while protecting road funding.

opts.label: Cut income taxes
opts.say: Skip the gimmick and promise permanent income tax cuts in year one.

events.title: Data center moratorium
events.prompt: Data centers are coming to Michigan townships and electric bills are rising. Do you pause them?

opts.label: Statewide moratorium
opts.say: Pause new data centers statewide and tighten utility regulation.

opts.label: Local control
opts.say: Let each community decide and require developers to pay for grid upgrades.

opts.label: Welcome investment
opts.say: Court data centers with an all of the above energy plan and lower taxes.

events.title: Distance from Trump
events.prompt: Trump's approval in Michigan is low and your rival keeps tying you to his war and tariffs. How close do you stay to the president?

opts.label: Run against Trump
opts.say: Make the race a referendum on Trump's war, tariffs and costs.

opts.label: Break on some issues
opts.say: Say you would break with the president on Iran and trade while keeping his tax agenda.

opts.label: Stand with Trump
opts.say: Embrace the president and say his policies will help Michigan.

events.title: Voter rolls and license errors
events.prompt: An audit found misprinted licenses and noncitizens on voter rolls before they were removed. How do you handle election integrity?

opts.label: Defend the system
opts.say: Say the errors were caught and fixed and Michigan is a model for secure elections.

opts.label: Promise an audit
opts.say: Call for an independent review of vendor contracts and voter list upkeep.

opts.label: Call it corruption
opts.say: Say the problems show incompetence or corruption and require proof of citizenship.

regions.name: Ann Arbor and Lansing
regions.note: University and capital counties that deliver big Democratic margins.

regions.name: West Michigan

regions.name: Upper Peninsula
regions.note: Remote, heavily Republican region with a Democratic pocket in Marquette.
